decision.reason: This turn I executed one concrete feasible action: measured F1:D_west's actual head/sill elevation ink on West_view.png (view_pixel_profile: cyan top peak y=440, bottom peak y=561, calibrated from the drawing's explicit 3000mm F1-height dimension labels, y=400->z=3.0m, y=600->z=0.0m), recorded it as claim_0001 (image_axis, resolved z≈[0.585,2.4]m) and adopted it, since this contradicts the candidate's current placeholder z=[0,2.1] for that opening. I confirmed via claim_status/prior claim_applications history that candidate_06 is the 6th and final allowed build/revise output (application_0003 already failed with 'candidate budget exhausted'), so revise_bim/confirm_claims cannot apply this or any other geometry/height/role correction in this run - confirm_claims would also reject it as an actual geometric change, not a no-op. No further build_bim/revise_bim/set_space_role action is executable in-scope this run. Remaining unresolved items (F2 exterior window height family, 14 unrecorded room-use roles, F1 south-side mirrored doors, the small entry recess) are documented in the saved candidate's assumptions/unresolved notes and in claim_0001, but cannot be corrected further without exceeding the hard 6-candidate cap. Delivering candidate_06 as-is is the most useful truthful outcome.
